notes:
### Added
- Resize tool (toolbar button 4, right-click on a selected model): click a
  model (Shift adds more) and type in the Measurements box: `2.5m` (size of
  the active axis, proportions kept), `w=1.2m` / `d=60cm` / `h=900mm`,
  `1.2m,0.6m,0.9m` (exact width, depth, height), `x1.5` or `150%`.
  Arrow keys pick the axis (Right width, Left depth, Up height). The model
  is resized along its own axes about its bottom centre, so it stays on the
  floor; one undo step. Box and dimensions are drawn on screen.
- Library management: drag a card onto a category to move it, double-click
  a name to rename it, right-click a category to rename/move the whole
  category, card menu "Replace with selection" swaps the stored model and
  thumbnail and keeps name/category/tags.

### Changed
- Clicking a card's name no longer places the model (it is used for
  renaming); click the picture to place.
